en.text: We have heard with our ears, God; have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你在古时，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你在古時，

en.text: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

zhSimplified.text: 你曾用手赶出外邦人，

zhTraditional.text: 你曾用手趕出外邦人，

en.text: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土，

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們不是靠自己的刀劍得地土，

en.text: God, you are my King. for Jacob!

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你是我的王； 得胜。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你是我的王； 得勝。

en.text: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

zhSimplified.text: 我们靠你要推倒我们的敌人，

zhTraditional.text: 我們靠你要推倒我們的敵人，

en.text: For I will not trust in my bow, will my sword save me.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，我必不靠我的弓；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，我必不靠我的弓；

en.text: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

zhSimplified.text: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人，

zhTraditional.text: 惟你救了我們脫離敵人，

en.text: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever.

zhSimplified.text: 我们终日因 神夸耀，

zhTraditional.text: 我們終日因上帝誇耀，

en.text: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

zhSimplified.text: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱，

zhTraditional.text: 但如今你丟棄了我們，使我們受辱，

en.text: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我们向敌人转身退后；

zhTraditional.text: 你使我們向敵人轉身退後；

en.text: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊，

zhTraditional.text: 你使我們當作快要被吃的羊，

en.text: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

zhSimplified.text: 你卖了你的子民也不赚利， 。

zhTraditional.text: 你賣了你的子民也不賺利， 。

en.text: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我们受邻国的羞辱，

zhTraditional.text: 你使我們受鄰國的羞辱，

en.text: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我们在列邦中作了笑谈，

zhTraditional.text: 你使我們在列邦中作了笑談，

en.text: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

zhSimplified.text: 我的凌辱终日在我面前，

zhTraditional.text: 我的凌辱終日在我面前，

en.text: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

zhSimplified.text: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音，

zhTraditional.text: 都因那辱罵毀謗人的聲音，

en.text: All this has come on us, we haven’t forgotten you. to your covenant.

zhSimplified.text: 这都临到我们身上，

zhTraditional.text: 這都臨到我們身上，

en.text: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

zhSimplified.text: 我们的心没有退后；

zhTraditional.text: 我們的心沒有退後；

en.text: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

zhSimplified.text: 你在野狗之处压伤我们，

zhTraditional.text: 你在野狗之處壓傷我們，

en.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

zhSimplified.text: 倘若我们忘了 神的名，

zhTraditional.text: 倘若我們忘了上帝的名，

en.text: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

zhSimplified.text: 神岂不鉴察这事吗？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝豈不鑒察這事嗎？

en.text: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

zhSimplified.text: 我们为你的缘故终日被杀；

zhTraditional.text: 我們為你的緣故終日被殺；

en.text: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? us forever.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，求你睡醒，为何尽睡呢？ ！

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，求你睡醒，為何儘睡呢？ ！

en.text: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

zhSimplified.text: 你为何掩面，

zhTraditional.text: 你為何掩面，

en.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的性命伏于尘土；

zhTraditional.text: 我們的性命伏於塵土；

en.text: Rise up to help us. us for your loving kindness’ sake.

zhSimplified.text: 求你起来帮助我们！

zhTraditional.text: 求你起來幫助我們！
